info.title: SmartFin API
info.description: Personal and family finance API. Amounts are decimal strings; instants are ISO 8601 UTC; financial dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

sessionCookie.name: sf_session
sessionCookie.description: Session cookie set by sign-in (named __Host-sf_session over HTTPS). State-changing requests also need the X-SmartFin-CSRF header.

bearer.description: Session token for the Android app (sign in with X-SmartFin-Client: android).

Health.description: Liveness: the API process is running.

Error.description: Every API error uses this shape.

Readiness.description: Readiness: the database is reachable and all migrations are applied.

csrfToken.description: Send as X-SmartFin-CSRF on state-changing requests made with the session cookie.
